risk.summary: Inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (317), strong dollar headwinds, and FOMC event just passed create severely adverse macro conditions for real estate sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold RSI (9) with ADX strong trend structure and EMA 50/200 bullish alignment creates textbook contrarian bounce setup near support (51.14), amplified by fear-zone sentiment (14/100 fear/greed).
debate.key_bear_argument: Complete absence of bullish confirmation—price below all moving averages, negative MACD, weak CMF, no OBV accumulation, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (317), and zero fundamental conviction (insider/institutional/government)—makes this a bear trap setup in a macro recession environment.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold RSI and fear-zone sentiment create contrarian appeal, but complete absence of bullish confirmation (price below all MAs, negative MACD, weak CMF, no OBV accumulation) and severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, recession risk) make this a bear trap rather than a swing opportunity.
